tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// sdom brtson zhig la spring ba bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dbus su legs 'khrungs shing*// ye shes bzhi yi rang bzhin las grub la// phrin las rnam bzhi'i bang rim nyer mdzes pa// rgyal ba lhun po'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa min yang 'phags pa'i ming can gyi// mngon sum min yang mngon sum ji bzhin du// dad dang dga' ba'i 'dzum zer legs bstan nas// sdom brtson khyed kyi snyan du 'di gsol lo// bdag cag bde bar sa skya'i chos grwar sleb bdog khyod kyang sku khams bde zhing*/ brtul zhugs dri ma med pa la gnas nas/ gcig tu dkar zhing rnam par dge ba'i mdzad spyod 'ba' zhig gis bdag dang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po bsgrubs nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi rgya mtshor nye bar gzhol zhing bzhugs pa khums shing*/ khyed thugs dge ba las byung ba'i// spring yig mthong bas bdag gi yid// dga' ba ngang gis 'phel ba ni// dbyar gyi chu klung ji bzhin no// gzhan yang skabs kyi don la/ sku khams legs par btsa' bar zhu/ thugs dam la brtson par bskul ci 'tshal/ khyed kyi gsung ltar nged kyis kyang*/ lha sde mi sde spyi la gang phan pa'i bkod pa byed pa lags/ yi ge'i rten la gsol ja bzang po khod cig dang*/ thugs dam gyi zhal khab rgyu dar bar ma yug gcig bdog bsil zer chu shel la phog ltar// spring yig gzigs pas khyed kyi thugs// dgyes pa'i chu gter rab 'phel nas// 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho'i gnas gyur cig /me mo glang gi lo/ khra'i zla ba'i tshes bzhi la sa skyar bris pa'i yi ge bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
